# TPOALOS

> Small command-line tools in pure Python with zero dependencies. Defensive and protective only. MIT licensed.

## Start here

- [hostguard](https://github.com/TPOALOS/hostguard): Read-only hardening auditor for Linux and macOS: 76 checks, score, HTML report, drift detection, offline root audits
- [detectlite](https://github.com/TPOALOS/detectlite): Sigma-compatible (subset) detection rule engine for local logs, with ATT&CK-mapped alerts and a tested starter ruleset
- [portlens](https://github.com/TPOALOS/portlens): Defensive attack-surface scanner (nmap-style): scope guard, rate caps, banner/TLS checks, policy and scan diff
- [pcaplens](https://github.com/TPOALOS/pcaplens): Pure-Python pcap/pcapng analyzer: TCP reassembly, scan/beacon/DNS-tunnel/credential detectors, CTF stream tools
- [ctfhost](https://github.com/TPOALOS/ctfhost): Dependency-free platform for hosting your own CTF: scrypt auth, CSRF, dynamic scoring, first blood, scoreboard
- [pocketledger](https://github.com/TPOALOS/pocketledger): Private, local, dependency-free personal finance ledger: bank CSV import, budgets, subscription detection, net worth, loans, HTML reports

## AI assistants and agents

- [cmdguard](https://github.com/TPOALOS/cmdguard): Allow, ask or deny shell commands proposed by an AI agent: a safety net and Claude Code PreToolUse hook, never runs the command
- [mcpaudit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/mcpaudit): Audit MCP server configs for risky settings: literal secrets, unpinned npx downloads, shells, plain-http remotes, broad file access
- [injectscan](https://github.com/TPOALOS/injectscan): Find hidden instructions aimed at AI assistants: invisible Unicode (decoded), hidden HTML, comments, padded text, encoded payloads
- [ctxpack](https://github.com/TPOALOS/ctxpack): Pack a project into one prompt-ready file for an AI assistant: respects .gitignore, leaves out secrets, redacts tokens, strips invisible Unicode
- [tokcount](https://github.com/TPOALOS/tokcount): Estimate tokens, context-window fit and cost for prompts, files and folders, offline; you supply model sizes and prices

## Things that quietly break, until they cost you

- [backupcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/backupcheck): Check that your backups exist, are fresh, plausible and readable: age, size drop, archive and checksum verification
- [jobwatch](https://github.com/TPOALOS/jobwatch): Notice when a cron job silently stops running: wrap the command, check later. Timeouts and overlap protection, no server
- [diskwatch](https://github.com/TPOALOS/diskwatch): Warn before a disk is full: space and inode levels, days-until-full forecast, biggest items
- [expirywatch](https://github.com/TPOALOS/expirywatch): Never miss an expiry date: passports, domains, certificates, insurance in one plain text file with warnings
- [certwatch](https://github.com/TPOALOS/certwatch): TLS certificate expiry checker for your own hosts, cron-friendly
- [cronnext](https://github.com/TPOALOS/cronnext): Validate and explain cron expressions and list next run times, no dependencies
- [dupefind](https://github.com/TPOALOS/dupefind): Find duplicate files by content and see the reclaimable space. Report only, deletes nothing

## Privacy and leaks

- [exifstrip](https://github.com/TPOALOS/exifstrip): See and remove hidden photo metadata (GPS, camera serial, owner) from JPEG and PNG files; keeps colour profile and rotation
- [secretscan](https://github.com/TPOALOS/secretscan): Dependency-free scanner for leaked secrets in files or staged git changes, with baselines
- [githook-guard](https://github.com/TPOALOS/githook-guard): One-command pre-commit hook that blocks secrets, .env and key files, oversized files and personal e-mail commits
- [gitidentity-audit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/gitidentity-audit): Find personal e-mail addresses leaked in git history across repos (read-only, stdlib-only Python)
- [logscrub](https://github.com/TPOALOS/logscrub): Redact secrets, emails, IPs and tokens from logs before sharing them
- [shellhist-scrub](https://github.com/TPOALOS/shellhist-scrub): Find and mask passwords, tokens and credentials typed into your zsh/bash history
- [envdrift](https://github.com/TPOALOS/envdrift): Detect drift between .env.example and .env files without ever printing values
- [pwlint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/pwlint): Judge a password honestly and generate strong ones, offline: never prints or sends the password
- [pwned-local](https://github.com/TPOALOS/pwned-local): Check passwords or SHA-1 hashes against a local HIBP-style sorted hash file with binary search, no network
- [pwhash-audit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/pwhash-audit): Audit shadow, htpasswd and user:hash files for weak schemes, empty passwords, reuse and bad permissions, no cracking

## Security checks for your own systems

- [listenwatch](https://github.com/TPOALOS/listenwatch): See what is listening on your machine and who can reach it: flags risky exposed services and new listeners
- [sshcfg-audit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/sshcfg-audit): Offline auditor for sshd_config and ssh client config with fix suggestions
- [sshkey-audit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/sshkey-audit): Read-only audit of ~/.ssh: keys without passphrase, weak key types, loose permissions, risky authorized_keys
- [authlog-summary](https://github.com/TPOALOS/authlog-summary): Read-only SSH auth log summarizer: failed logins per IP, targeted users, odd successes
- [fimcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/fimcheck): Simple file integrity monitor: SHA-256 baseline and change report
- [permaudit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/permaudit): Read-only file permission auditor: world-writable, SUID, loose keys and .env files
- [headercheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/headercheck): Grade the HTTP security headers of a site you operate, with fixes
- [jwtlint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/jwtlint): Offline JWT inspector that flags alg none, missing expiry and sensitive claims, without verifying signatures
- [mailtriage](https://github.com/TPOALOS/mailtriage): Offline e-mail header triage: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, spoofing signs, relay path and a risk verdict
- [urlcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/urlcheck): Spot phishing signs in a URL without opening it: look-alike domains, @ tricks, obfuscated IPs
- [pathaudit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/pathaudit): Audit your PATH for current-dir hijack, writable or foreign-owned dirs, symlinks, duplicates and shadowed commands
- [symlinkcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/symlinkcheck): Scan a directory tree for dangling, escaping, looping and sensitive-target symlinks without following them
- [sudoers-audit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/sudoers-audit): Lint sudoers files for NOPASSWD:ALL, broad rules, wildcards, shell-escape commands and risky Defaults
- [elfcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/elfcheck): checksec-style ELF hardening checker (PIE, NX, RELRO, canary, FORTIFY, RPATH) that never executes anything
- [iocgrep](https://github.com/TPOALOS/iocgrep): Scan logs and files for IOCs (IPs, CIDRs, domains, URLs, hashes), defang-aware, with file hashing and --json

## Cloud, APIs and DNS

- [planguard](https://github.com/TPOALOS/planguard): Report risky Terraform plan changes before apply: destroy/replace of critical resources, open ports, public S3, encryption off
- [iamlint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/iamlint): Offline linter for AWS IAM, S3, KMS and SQS policy JSON: wildcards, public principals, PassRole, privilege-escalation combos
- [apispec-lint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/apispec-lint): Security lint of OpenAPI 3.x and Swagger 2.0 JSON specs: http servers, missing auth, weak OAuth, sensitive fields
- [zonelint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/zonelint): Offline lint of BIND DNS zone files: SOA/NS sanity, CNAME conflicts, SPF/DMARC/CAA, takeover-prone targets

## Web servers and e-mail

- [nginxcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/nginxcheck): Lint nginx configs for TLS weaknesses, missing headers, alias traversal and proxy_pass SSRF smells
- [cookiecheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/cookiecheck): Offline lint of Set-Cookie headers, HTTP responses and HAR files: missing flags, prefix violations, broad Domain
- [mailauth-lint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/mailauth-lint): Offline linter for SPF, DMARC and DKIM DNS record text: lookup limits, weak policy, short keys
- [dmarc-report](https://github.com/TPOALOS/dmarc-report): Summarise DMARC aggregate report XML (also .gz/.zip) offline: per-source alignment, failing senders, pass rate

## Untrusted files

- [zipcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/zipcheck): Inspect zip/tar archives for zip-slip, hostile links, special files, setuid and bombs without extracting
- [csvguard](https://github.com/TPOALOS/csvguard): Scan CSV/TSV for spreadsheet formula injection with cell coordinates; writes an atomic sanitized copy
- [trojansrc](https://github.com/TPOALOS/trojansrc): Scan source files for Trojan Source attacks: bidi controls, invisible characters, homoglyph identifiers

## Developer hygiene

- [repolint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/repolint): Is this project ready to share? Offline checklist for README, licence, tracked secrets, tests, CI and broken README links
- [gha-audit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/gha-audit): Offline security auditor for GitHub Actions workflows: unpinned actions, script injection, risky triggers
- [dockerfile-audit](https://github.com/TPOALOS/dockerfile-audit): Offline security linter for Dockerfiles: root user, unpinned images, baked-in secrets, curl|sh
- [reqpin](https://github.com/TPOALOS/reqpin): Supply-chain audit for pip requirements files: unpinned versions, missing hashes, typosquat lookalikes
- [npmscan](https://github.com/TPOALOS/npmscan): Offline audit of package.json and npm lockfiles for install scripts, git/http deps, odd registries, typosquats
- [signcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/signcheck): Audit git commit-signing hygiene: signature status, unsigned merges, identity/date mismatches, CI exit codes

## Finance

- [backtestlint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/backtestlint): Find look-ahead bias and data leakage in Python backtest code: 14 AST-based rules, notebooks, SARIF
- [ohlcvlint](https://github.com/TPOALOS/ohlcvlint): Lint OHLCV price data for bad bars, duplicates, gaps, unadjusted splits, spikes and stale prices
- [riskmetrics](https://github.com/TPOALOS/riskmetrics): Performance statistics with bootstrap intervals and multiple-testing corrections: deflated Sharpe, Holm, drawdowns
- [edgelab](https://github.com/TPOALOS/edgelab): Trial ledger and honest edge report for trading ideas: counts every variant, tests a holdout, stresses costs
- [costmap](https://github.com/TPOALOS/costmap): Map net Sharpe across transaction costs and volatility regimes with no look-ahead labels
- [slipcheck](https://github.com/TPOALOS/slipcheck): Measure real slippage and fee cost of your fills with a bootstrap interval and check your backtest cost assumption
- [ruinsim](https://github.com/TPOALOS/ruinsim): Bootstrap your trade list: drawdown and risk of ruin by position size, with Kelly and block resampling
- [strategy-graveyard](https://github.com/TPOALOS/strategy-graveyard): Classic trading rules on null random-walk markets: what does luck look like, and does your history beat it?
